title: Online PC-parts shop
subtitle: Imports graphics cards; new tariffs are in the news
text: I run a small online shop in Hanoi that imports graphics cards from Taiwan for gamers and small studios. A mid-range card sells for $420 and costs me about $330 landed, and I sell around 90 a week. Orders from my distributor take about 4 weeks to arrive and I keep roughly 3 weeks of stock, with about $40,000 spare for more. My main rival, TechNova, sells the same card for $415.
